accepted_scope: The existing six mutations m1-m6 use temporary repository and agent-root fixtures rather than changing the real repository or user prompt files.
Each mutation changes the intended fixture bytes and is detected by newly introduced matching FAIL reasons relative to an independently measured baseline.
An already-red baseline, missing checker or ineffective mutation is not counted as a detected mutation.
The locked implementation, selected protected files and selected user directories had identical start/end hashes or listings during independent verification.
explicit_limits: This is not an operating-system sandbox. Arbitrary code, direct absolute-path writes or code bypassing the fixture API are outside the accepted scope.
The direct-open symlink counterexample is recorded. It is unreachable through the reviewed m1-m6 paths and is not accepted as a general confinement guarantee.
The Python-side write audit was incomplete and returned UNVERIFIED. It does not prove all native-process writes or all user directories were observed.
SIGKILL may leave temporary fixtures. POSIX paths and all 28 checker implementations were not independently verified.
Changed checker dependencies or additional mutations require impact review and relevant independent revalidation.
This decision does not accept nine-domain behavior, deployment equivalence, a full release or the overall Goal.
